To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a conditional adversarial face aging framework, named conditional adversarial auto-encoder (CAAE), that learns a face aging manifold, traversing of which smooth age progression/ regression can be realized, and that no paired samples are required.

we propose to solve the problem of face aging from a generative perspective, which does not require the labeled query image and paired samples, and we show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-arts in terms of both age progression/regression and face generation.
our method can generate realistic faces of different ages from a single face image and that it can also generate realistic faces from an arbitrary image.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following two aspects: (1) how to learn the face manifold that is able to generate realistic faces with desired age attributes; (2) how to learn an age progression/regression path on the face manifold that can generate realistic images for arbitrary ages.
the following two aspects: (1) how to learn the face manifold for age progression/regression; and (2) how to generate photo-realistic faces with the desired age attribute from the learned manifold.

the proposed CAAE can generate photo-realistic face images with arbitrary age, and the generated face images are more similar to ground truth than those generated by the existing methods.
we propose a novel generative model that can generate photo-realistic faces at different ages.

the CAAE framework provides a novel and powerful tool for age progression/regression, which is able to generate photo-realistic face images with desired age attribute without requiring paired samples.

, given a face image, we can generate its aged version (e.g., 80) and its young version (e.g. 5).
we are able to age a face from a query image to a target age without any paired sample, and the generative model allows us to age a query image in either forward or reverse directions.
